key_points.text: In this episode from July 2018, A16Z co-founder Ben Horowitz discusses mentorship with his mentor, Silicon Valley pioneer Ken Coleman and Ben's mentee.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode from July 2018, A16Z co-founder Ben Horowitz discusses mentorship with his mentor, Silicon Valley pioneer Ken Coleman and Ben's mentee, Michelle Feaster, founder of usermind and now chief product officer at Qualtricks.

key_points.text: They begin with their personal journeys and share advice and frameworks for mentorship, leadership, and growing as a founder and CEO.

thesis: The episode explores the mentor-mentee relationship as a critical component of career and life success, emphasizing that effective mentors look beyond resumes to identify personal drive and potential. It argues that individuals must possess the ability to perform 'intelligent override' by finding side doors to opportunities rather than relying on broken or unhelpful corporate systems.
